cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. What is held instead is two central systems: SIGEF, through which taxpayers declare to the General Directorate of Contributions and Taxes, and KONTAKTU, a piloted online tax payment platform connected to it. Neither is stated as serving a local government, and whether any keeps a digital revenue record is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. The central systems are noted and place nothing.
